name: People paging and activation filters use the server query
title: SC-12-04-01 People paging and activation filters use the server query
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the people directory contains more than one page
When the manager opens the next page and filters for pending activation
Then the requested page and filter are sent to the directory API
And the matching people are shown through the shared directory scaffold

testSteps.description: [flutter-test] flutter/test/people_directory_test.dart::pages through the directory and filters people waiting for
